    Buying laminates in Kakinada

    Laminate
    questions.

    For homeowners, carpenters, interior designers, architects and builders. Still unsure? Call or WhatsApp us and we will help you choose.

    What are laminates used for?
    Laminates are decorative sheets fixed onto plywood or boards to give furniture a finished surface. They are used on kitchens, wardrobes, office furniture and tables.
    Should I choose laminate or veneer?
    Choose veneer for the genuine look and warmth of real wood, polished to the shade you want. Choose laminate for a hard-wearing, easy-clean surface on kitchens, wardrobes and office furniture.
    Which board should go under laminate in a kitchen?
    BWP plywood is the usual base for kitchen cabinets because it copes with moisture far better than ordinary plywood. All Liveteck plywood is BWP grade.
    Can I see the designs before I buy?
    Yes. Visit our Temple Street store to see the woodgrains, solid colours and textures in person, or ask us on WhatsApp.
    Do your laminates come with a warranty?
    Yes. Liveteck laminates come with a lifetime warranty. Ask our team for the warranty details when you buy.
    How do I get laminate prices?
    Prices depend on the design and the quantity. Send us your list on WhatsApp (+91 99121 53030) and we will reply with prices and availability.
